title: Getting Unbiased Estimates of Stroke volume Study (GUESS): PRAM vs. clinical-based Cardiac Output Assessment in Children Undergoing Congenital Cardiac Surgery and Adults Undergoing Major Surgery
summary: The aim of the study is to assess whether this additional information on “heart time volume” is helpful for clinicians and whether the assessment of circulation using existing methods is reliable. In addition, the study will investigate whether PRAM can support clinicians in their therapeutic decisions.
conditions: Children with congenital heart defects and adults undergoing major surgery

interventions.name: Once written consent has been obtained, everything proceeds according to clinic standards on the day of the operation. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Children (0-18 years) undergoing elective cardiac surgery with indication for extended hemodynamic monitoring
Adults (18-90 years) undergoing elective major surgery with indication for extended hemodynamic monitoring
Exclusion criteria:
Children and adults without advanced hemodynamic monitoring
Lack of informed consent
